# Yuitility — Privacy-First Local Browser Utilities & Calculators

> Yuitility (https://www.yuitility.app) is an online platform offering 150+ free, high-precision browser tools for financial calculations, PDF operations, image compression, developer utilities, and everyday converters. All processing occurs 100% locally in client-side WebAssembly / JavaScript memory with zero server uploads, no accounts, and no tracking.

## Core Platform Attributes
- Website URL: https://www.yuitility.app
- Total Tools: 152+ Live Tools
- Privacy Standard: 100% In-Browser Local Execution (Zero Server Data Retention)
- Account System: No Registration, No Paywalls, Free Forever
- Speed: Instant client rendering (Zero Network Roundtrips)

## Key Tool Categories
1. Calculators & Math: Standard Calculator, Scientific Calculator, Mean, Median, Mode, Standard Deviation, Permutations, Matrix Solver, Quadratic Solver, Geometry, Logarithms.
2. Finance & Wealth: EMI Calculator, Loan Calculator, Salary Take-Home Calculator, SIP Calculator, SWP Calculator, EPF Calculator, Income Tax, GST, Crypto PnL, Stock Average.
3. Text & Developer Tools: Password Generator, Fake Data Generator, JSON Formatter, Base64 Encoder, Regex Tester, Diff Checker, UUID Generator, HTML Entity Encoder.
4. PDF Tools: PDF Merge, PDF Split, PDF Compress, PDF Rotate, PDF Page Removal (Offline WebAssembly engine).
5. Image & Media: Image Compressor, Image Converter (WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG), Resizer, Background Removal.
6. Health & Lifestyle: BMI Calculator, BMR Calculator, Body Fat Percentage, Daily Calorie Intake, Water Intake, Sleep Cycle, Pregnancy Due Date.
